name: How does the Colorado climate affect log home maintenance requirements?

mainEntity.name: How does the Colorado climate affect log home maintenance requirements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Colorado’s high altitude, intense UV radiation, low humidity, and rapid temperature swings cause log timbers to dry out, check, and lose protective coatings faster than in humid climates. South-facing log walls in areas like Parker, Franktown, or Larkspur face severe solar degradation, while winter freeze-thaw cycles pull moisture into open log checks and joints. Routine maintenance along the Front Range requires checking sealants, monitoring checks facing upward that catch snowmelt, and maintaining UV-blocking exterior stains before high-elevation sunlight bleaches the wood fibers.
acceptedAnswer.description: High elevation and strong UV exposure break down exterior finishes quickly, requiring regular sealant checks and UV-resistant stain maintenance.
